method.description: Import-graph walk from every Next entry point.
method.detail: Every route/page/layout/loading/error/not-found/template/default module, middleware and instrumentation is an entry. Each file's static import specifiers were resolved through the `@/` and relative aliases and walked transitively; a module is LIVE only if an entry reaches it. Route handler files are entries by definition, so 'no importer' does not make a route dead - it is checked separately.
method.caveat: Dynamic imports and runtime-only requires were not resolved, and no test file counts as an entry. Both caveats make the verdict conservative in the safe direction here: the only surviving importers of a dead module are its own unit tests.
